      "sentence": "After a new heart failure drug was added, the patient reported improved dyspnea and peripheral edema, but examination showed bilateral, mildly tender breast enlargement.",

      "sentence": "Tender gynecomastia is a characteristic adverse effect of spironolactone because it blocks androgen receptors.",

    },
    {
      "sentence": "In the kidney, spironolactone blocks mineralocorticoid receptors in principal cells of the cortical collecting duct, reducing sodium reabsorption and helping relieve congestion.",

    },
